periodic.source: GOB 400 supplies type-2 ViralDOT total 59, interval 2.5 s and 15 s lifetime. tempmods.py ViralDOT rounds each tick and applies damage and FX.

periodic.test: AbilityHostileTests.PlagueZoneAppliesFiveActualHealthTicksAndThenStops observes the first HP update, five 10-point actual ticks and no sixth tick. Shared viral tick FX is covered by AbilityTargetTests.PlagueZoneIsDamageOverTime.

proc.source: GOB 468 has a 50% proc on its 0.1 s term marker passing fixed value 6 to tempmods.py ApplyStunWithTimer.
proc.runtime: AbilityCatalog.Controls installs the marker. TimedEffects runs one roll per landed copy; AbilityConditionalControls.Term installs six-second stun and immunity only if immunity is absent.
proc.test: AbilityHostileTests.DevastationFieldRollsAtLandingAndStunsOnlyOnTermWithoutImmunity checks both sides of the 50% boundary, marker delay, immune rejection and actual stun/immunity expiry. The exact native refusal line is still open.
